note: Five interlocking rings cannot fit SOLO48: the top rings must stay 8 apart (spacing 2s >= 2r+8) while each crosses the lower ring between them (|offset| < 2r); in 40 units (4s+2r <= 40) this only works for r <= 4. The one integer interlock (r6, offset (6,6)) makes neighbouring top rings tangent so they merge, which is the rejected drawing.
